methodology.execution: Node.js WebAssembly versus native executable; no browser worker transfer time
methodology.wasmSolve: callMain only; V8 JIT may continue warming during repetitions
methodology.nativeSolve: process launch + dynamic loader + command; OS file cache is warm after warmup
methodology.setup: Pack read and cryptographic verification measured separately once, excluded from per-command timing
methodology.comparison: Accuracy parity uses native-count (same SR candidate count); native-original retains upstream half-second CPU cap and is separately reported
limitations: One host; timing is not a universal speed claim.
Numerical regression and external-reference checks are not formal proof.
No non-gravitational forces or asteroid perturber ephemeris.

fixtures.note: Copied byte-for-byte from origin/main; JPL Horizons fixtures retain their original query/result metadata. MPC records are supplied observations, not independent orbital truth.
